verdict.rationale: Appwrite's API reference pages have an 'Open in explorer' console. It loads the OpenAPI document, builds request forms, and executes real requests against the user's own project, with cURL export. The official specs repo also ships SDK code examples, so the reference is both interactive and example-backed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer; evidence that the SDK code examples themselves are directly runnable in-page, rather than only the request forms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: a vendor-built client-side API explorer that loads the OpenAPI document, builds request forms, and executes real requests (guest mode, user-JWT impersonation, or API keys) with cURL export
This repository contains the official Appwrite API specifications and SDK code examples for all supported versions
